Subject: Trial environment options & evaluation plan — hosted vs dedicated vs VPC

Hi Lena — thanks again for the quick sync today. Recap and suggested plan below so we have a single source of truth.

Call recap (quick):
- Goal: validate Redwood for Acme’s customer-facing summarization pipeline (low-latency generation + embedding similarity).
- Key success criteria (as discussed):
  1) Latency: 95th percentile generation < 250ms for 512-token bursts
  2) Cost: per-call token cost within the target envelope you shared (~$0.0008/token equivalent)
  3) Quality: automated eval pass rate >= 85% on your 120-case prompt suite
  4) Security: no customer PII persists beyond retention window, KMS integration for keys if VPC

Recommended evaluation plan (proposed):
- Phase 1 (Day 0–7): Hosted sandbox (fastest path) — Redwood will provision a dedicated sandbox project in our hosted environment with a pinned model + logging enabled. Purpose: functional validation and automated quality runs against your prompt set.
- Phase 2 (Day 8–14): Dedicated sandbox (if performance/cost tuning required) — reserved GPU pool under Acme tenant for realistic throughput testing and latency SLOs.
- Option: VPC/private trial (3+ weeks) — for procurement/security teams that require private networking, KMS/HSM, and on-prem-like isolation. Longer lead time due to network and compliance checks.

Ownership & timelines:
- Redwood provisioning (hosted sandbox): Marissa Cole — 48 hours to spin up, include API keys, example prompts, and runbook.
- Dedicated sandbox estimate: Priyom Das (infra ops) — 7 business days to allocate and configure GPU pool + autoscale policies.
- VPC trial lead & compliance: Rachel Kim (security) — needs to confirm KMS integration and sign-off; estimate 3+ weeks.

Immediate next steps (please confirm):
1) Acme confirms which route to start with: hosted sandbox (recommended) or jump straight to dedicated/VPC.
2) Share the prompt set (if any remaining items) and the canonical success-case spreadsheet.
3) Schedule kickoff demo and access handoff — proposed Monday 2026-04-19 at 10:00 PT.

Attachments: I’m attaching a short trial runbook and the template we use to capture success metrics.

If that all looks good I’ll ask Marissa to provision the hosted sandbox immediately and send credentials.

Thanks,
Karthik
